original.value: A full-body anime girl character design on a plain white background, centered and floating slightly, drawn in a soft minimalist pastel style with very thin gray linework and delicate flat colors. She has a petite youthful build and a cute, gentle silhouette, with special emphasis on a soft rounded face shape, smooth cheeks, and a softened jawline and chin. Her face is completely obscured by a blank skin-colored rectangular block with no facial features visible. She has short bob hair in {argument name="hair color" default="light ash brown"}, slightly tousled with wispy ends, long bangs covering part of the forehead, and a small ribbon hair tie on the right side in pale blue-gray. She wears 3 visible clothing pieces: an oversized pale blue cardigan with loose sleeves and front buttons, a cream-white slip dress with a scalloped neckline and a tiny button detail at the chest, and a frilled hem with a small ribbon near the right thigh. She is barefoot with slim pale legs, posed front-facing with both arms relaxed slightly outward, open hands, one leg straight and the other gently bent inward for a shy, weightless look. The illustration should feel airy, cute, understated, and clean, like a simple Japanese anime fashion sketch, with lots of negative space and no props, no shadows, and no background elements.

zh-CN.value: 一个全身动漫女孩角色设计，背景为纯白色，居中并略微悬浮，采用柔和的极简粉彩风格绘制，线条为非常细的灰色，色彩为精致的平涂色。她身材娇小年轻，轮廓可爱柔和，特别强调圆润柔和的脸型、光滑的脸颊以及柔和的下颌线和下巴。她的脸被一个空白的肤色矩形块完全遮挡，没有可见的面部特征。她有{argument name="hair color" default="light ash brown"}色的短波波头，发梢略带凌乱，有长长的刘海遮住部分额头，右侧系着一条淡蓝灰色的小丝带发饰。她穿着3件可见的服装：一件宽松的淡蓝色开衫，袖子宽松，前面有纽扣；一件奶油白色吊带裙，有荷叶边领口，胸前有一个小纽扣装饰，右侧大腿附近有荷叶边下摆和一个小丝带。她赤脚，腿细长肤色浅，正面站立，双臂略微向外放松，双手张开，一条腿伸直，另一条腿轻轻向内弯曲，呈现出害羞、无重量的姿态。插图应感觉轻盈、可爱、含蓄和干净，就像简单的日本动漫时尚素描，有大量留白，没有道具、阴影和背景元素。
